name: Self-supervised Part-Relation Graph — R0 feasibility probe
scope: VERY SMALL feasibility probe only (task book 9.4). If part discovery is unstable across normal references -> stop immediately, do NOT enter real-anomaly evaluation.

data.normal_refs_per_class: the 4 train/good references of each of the 6 classes (from manifest categories[cat]['0']['4']); no test images, no GT used
data.features: cached dino vitb14 patch features (outputs/dynamic_fusion/v3_direction_a/features_vitb14_s0_k4/anomalydino_visual) + raw image read for the same refs

part_discovery.pre_registered: KMeans (fixed k=6, seed 0) on per-patch concatenation [L2-normalized DINO feature, spatial coord/16 * 0.5]; node = cluster: appearance centroid (mean member patch), position (mean coord), area (count), shape (2nd moment) ; k=6 within pre-registered 4-16 window
part_discovery.per_image: each of the 4 reference images independently -> 6 part nodes

cross_reference_matching.method: chain matching across the 4 refs: Hungarian on node cost = (1 - cos(appearance_centroids)) + 0.5 * normalized position distance
cross_reference_matching.success_definition: node from image t is 'successfully matched' if its matched node in image t+1 has centroid cosine >= 0.85 AND normalized position displacement <= 0.15; success rate = mean fraction over the 3 links

gates.g1_node_matching: mean success rate across classes >= 0.90 -> only then continue to relation-score stability & counterfactual gates; else immediate stop/archive
gates.g2_relation_stability: deferred (needs g1 pass): relation-score 95th percentile stable under mild normal augmentation
gates.g3_counterfactual: deferred (needs g1+g2): synthetic delete/swap of one stable node has Cohen's d >= 1 vs normal augmentation

leakage: probe uses normal reference images only; no gt; no test statistics
